lookback_notes: NOT_FOUND. Audit Area 9 (Missing Plan of Care) on p. 8 states only that the claim will be disallowed if the plan of care is missing; it states no observation/look-back window for the assessor. The related Area 10 on the same page states a review frequency (upon a change of condition or at least every 6 months) for updating the plan of care, but that is a review-frequency requirement of a different audit area, not a look-back window for Area 9.

federal_coding_rules.rule: A plan of care must be present in the record; if the plan of care is missing, the claim will be disallowed.
